title: Route Concierge: telemetry-driven suggestions for region/tier fallback policies
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Objective:
Build a Console-first feature — Route Concierge — that surfaces telemetry-driven suggestions and safety checks while customers author region selection, tier routing, and fallback model variants. The Concierge helps customers create production-safe routing policies by combining historical traffic telemetry, SLO/latency budgets, and cost signals to propose candidate routing trees and highlight risks.

Why this: customers regularly ask for guidance when mapping their app SLAs to region/tier fallback rules. They also make subtle mistakes (overly broad fallbacks, missing regional exclusions, forgetting quantized variants) that surface only in production. The Console should catch these earlier and reduce misconfigurations, rollout surprises, and cost surprises.

Core goals:
- Provide ranked, telemetry-backed suggestions for region order, tier preference, and fallback model variants with an explainable confidence score.
- Surface risk warnings (e.g., cross-region latency spikes, tier saturation) and cost delta estimates for each suggested route.
- Allow previews/simulations against recorded traffic slices (synthetic replay and historical heatmaps).
- Integrate with existing rollout controls (canary percent, automatic fallback thresholds) and provide one-click apply or save-as-template.

User stories:
1) As a platform engineer, I want the Console to recommend an order of regions for a given traffic profile so I can meet 99th percentile latency SLOs without manual tuning.
2) As a product engineer, I want fallback variant recommendations (quantized/flash/float) that minimize degradation while respecting cost caps.
3) As an operator, I want an explainable preview showing latency, token-cost, and SLO-risk for my routing tree before I apply it.

Scope (MVP):
- UI: Suggestion panel in Policy Editor with ranked suggestions and inline explainability pane.
- Validation: Lint rules that flag missing fallbacks, circular dependencies, and unsafe region crossovers.
- Previews: Historical replay on up to 7 days of traffic (customer-selected slice) + a compact latency/cost delta chart.
- Templates: Ability to accept suggestion, tweak, and save as org template.

Out of scope for MVP: real-time continuous policy recommendation during runtime (follow-up), fine-grained per-model quantization advice (R&D track), multi-account cross-tenant suggestions.

Trade-offs and design decisions considered:
- On-device heuristics vs server-side ML model: we will start with server-side rule-based heuristics enriched by telemetry percentiles; a lightweight ML ranker is planned for Q3.
- Privacy: telemetry suggestions operate on aggregated, anonymized metrics scoped to the customer. No raw request content will be used.
- UX complexity: we favor a progressive disclosure UI (summary + expand for details) to avoid clutter for new users.

Acceptance criteria (MVP):
- Console shows at least 3 ranked suggestions for any authored policy that involves region or tier decisions.
- Each suggestion includes: confidence score (0-100), estimate of 95th-latency delta, token-cost delta per 1M requests, and a short reason summary.
- Lint layer raises warnings/errors for the three defined unsafe patterns and links to remediation.
- Preview simulation runs within 20s for a selected 24-hour traffic slice (typical dataset).
- Templates saved from suggestions are visible under Organization > Routing Templates.

Telemetry and signals used:
- Region 95th and 99th latency percentiles by endpoint and route.
- Per-tier saturation (%) and queueing latency.
- Model variant cold-start frequency and per-token cost rates.
- Recent error spike counts and retry amplification factors.

Mockups and artifacts:
- PRD: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/ROUTE/Route+Concierge+PRD
- Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/Route-Concierge-v1 (frame: SuggestionPanel)
- Prototype video: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1xY-route-concierge-proto
- Spike docs (telemetry schemas): https://docs.redwood.ai/telemetry/routing-summaries

Operational considerations:
- Telemetry extraction job (ENG) to produce daily routing summaries per org. Tagged dependency: ENG-3412.
- Compute cost: suggestion generation will be triggered on policy edit/save, batched, and cached for 24h.
- Auditing: suggestions and applied templates must be recorded in audit logs for compliance review.

Risk: over-reliance on past telemetry may miss sudden capacity outages or new regions; include an explicit confidence disclaimer and require canary rollouts for high-risk changes.
acceptance_criteria: Shows >=3 ranked suggestions with confidence and deltas
Lint flags: missing fallback, circular routing, cross-region data concerns
Templates saved and visible in Org templates
